public_definitions: The chart displays the number of samples tested over time, with the y-axis representing the count and the x-axis representing the month.
The goal is to route the testing record to the operational follow-up that best matches the volume pattern shown over the reporting window.

The options are: 'Route the testing-volume record to rising-volume capacity planning', 'Route the testing-volume record to declining-volume outreach review', and 'Route the testing-volume record to general laboratory operations review'.
